newsitem.title: USA: Clinton slips off campaign trail for Hillary gift.
newsitem.headline: Clinton slips off campaign trail for Hillary gift.

text.p: President Bill Clinton celebrates his 21st wedding anniversary with Hillary Rodham Clinton on Friday and he will not be empty-handed when they exchange gifts.
In the middle of a 16-hour campaign day on Thursday that took him to Tennessee, Ohio and Kentucky, Clinton still found a moment to poke through a department store in downtown Dayton.
Consulting deputy White House chief of staff Evelyn Lieberman, Clinton made his choice at Elder-Beerman department store and paid with a Visa card.

It was all cloaked in mystery but there was a frantic search by store employees to find the right box for the gift. White House officials declined to say what he bought, saying he wanted to keep it a surprise.
